elaine: Quick q — we're finalizing the client guidance for 429s. Do we plan to expose a `Retry-After` + a per-route `X-Quota-Window` header so SDKs can implement exponential vs fixed backoff?

mike: I think `Retry-After` should remain the canonical one. Adding a `X-Quota-Window` OK but it's opt-in for routes with burst grace.

sasha: +1 on keeping `Retry-After` canonical. Important: SDKs need deterministic behavior when we return fallback models (different rate limits). Maybe include `X-Model-Variant` when we downgrade.

oliver: Real-world note: some clients ignore `Retry-After` and hammer. We should add `X-RateLimit-Bucket` (opaque id) so proxies/SDKs can coalesce retries per-bucket. Helps with burst smoothing.

elaine: Good point. So minimal set: `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Bucket`. Optional: `X-Quota-Window` and `X-Model-Variant`. Does that sound right?

mike: That's my vote. Also document semantics: `X-RateLimit-Remaining` can be -1 for unknown, and `Retry-After` is in seconds. Keep JSON body small for compatibility.

deploy-bot: deploy:rate-limit-service v3.4 rolled to staging at 2026-03-10T14:22Z — added `X-RateLimit-Bucket` header (opaque).

kate: For backward compatibility, if a client reads `X-Quota-Window` but server doesn't return it, treat as "no grace window". Avoid changing 429 status code mapping.

elaine: @sasha about fallback models — will `X-Model-Variant` be present on both 200 and 429 responses?

sasha: Yes. We decided to surface it everywhere so telemetry aligns. Format: `model-name@variant` e.g., `redwood-3b@quant`.

mike: One more: should we include human-readable `error.message` in body for 429s? We currently return just {"error":{"type":"rate_limit","message":"..."}} — short message ok.

elaine: Keep the body small but include `request_id` for support. Example 429 headers and body:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 8
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Bucket: r-7f4c1a
X-Quota-Window: 10
X-Model-Variant: redwood-3b@fp16
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"rate_limit","message":"quota exceeded"}, "request_id":"req_abc123"}
```

oliver: That example is great. Suggest adding note: `X-Quota-Window` units are seconds and indicate server-side grace period during which bursts may be tolerated. SDKs should prefer `Retry-After` for retry timing but use `X-Quota-Window` to decide circuit-breaker behavior.

kate: Also call out Dedicated customers might get stricter `X-RateLimit-Remaining` accuracy; hosted can be optimistic with cache. Add a short line in the contract doc.

elaine: Sounds like consensus. Action items: mike to update spec docs, sasha to ensure model variant header is emitted for fallbacks, oliver to add SDK guidance note about coalescing retries by bucket. I'll PR the contract draft today. :thumbsup:

mike: Filing doc PR now.

sasha: I'll add tests to the fallback path.

oliver: I'll drop a short snippet into go/python SDKs tomorrow.

elaine: Thanks all — ping here when PR is up.
